rod-help: Hold bait in your off-hand. Right-click toward water to cast, right-click when you see '!' to hook. Hold right-click to reel, tilt mouse left/right to steer.
fishing-nobait: You need bait in your off-hand.
fishing-nowater: Aim at open water to cast.
fishing-nothingbites: Nothing here would go for that bait with this rod.
fishing-missed: Too slow - the fish took the bait and left.
fishing-toofar: The line went slack - you've drifted too far.
hud-controls: Hold RMB: reel   |   Move Mouse: tilt rod against the fish
